output.subject: Why young private equity funds first show a loss
output.body: Dear Johanna, you asked about the capital call. In the first years a private equity fund calls money and pays fees before its companies grow, so its value often looks negative. This is called the J-curve. It is normal and usually turns later. Happy to explain on a call. Best, Jonas
